fem.text: The goblins fight alongside the orcs in the fall of Sarpadia's empires, as the Icatian army easily repels early orc surprise attacks on border towns like Montford. Goblin and Orcish armies then crush the sparsely defended Dwarven cities with War Drums, and the dwarves' civilization is the first to fall, its name sadly lost.

Icatia, weakened by the Farrelite Cult, finally falls to orcs, goblins, thrulls and thallids aided by Tevesh Szat, but the thrulls later destroy the goblins and the last of the orcs and keep evolving, content with their isolation.
